content_sections.heading: IIBF Faculty Member Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIBF to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIBF Faculty Member recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIBF Faculty Member positions is 21 September 2026. Ensure you complete the process before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Faculty Member post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Faculty Member post advertised by the Indian Institute of Banking & Finance (IIBF).

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 55 years, and the maximum age limit is 62 years for the Faculty Member positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Faculty Member role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Faculty Member position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications required for the Faculty Member post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree along with CA/CMA/CFA and CAIIB, or an MBA/PGDBA/PGDBM (Banking & Finance) with 2 years of experience, or a Ph.D. in a related field.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IIBF Faculty Member recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Faculty Member role primarily involves a Personal Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in this interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job (permanent or contract)?
faq.answer: The Faculty Member positions are offered on a contract basis, as indicated in the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the IIBF located?
faq.answer: The Indian Institute of Banking & Finance (IIBF) is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with a pincode of 400070.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply through offline mode?
faq.answer: No, applications for the IIBF Faculty Member recruitment must be submitted strictly through the online mode. Offline applications will not be considered.
